Updated the existing `treasury-bulletin-capital-movements` skill and compressed/updated memory.

Generalizable lesson saved:
For Treasury Bulletin capital-movements questions involving USD→GBP conversion, explicitly verify exchange-rate direction. “USD to GBP” means GBP per USD and should be multiplied after rounding that direct rate; if the source gives GBPUSD / USD per GBP, divide by the rounded USD-per-GBP rate instead. For June 30, 2002, using a wrong nearby/averaged quote around 0.66 instead of about 0.63 can overstate the GBP result by ~4–5%.
